what: A 100px disc cursor starts about 45ms late and follows the cursor position to center over .2s easeOut(0,0,.58,1). data-fx-part="zone" On entering a spot, the cursor switches on in .2s linear with that spot’s type (data-cursor: view text · scroll down arrow · rotate rotating arrow · otherwise text) and fill (data-cursor-bg · data-cursor-ink, the brand color per work), with a 2px ring of the same color set 2px apart. Each click on a rotate spot turns the disc 180° in .2s, and it returns to 0° when leaving that spot’s parent. Outside a spot · data-cursor="none" Off above this (under 1025px · absent on touch)

options.below: Off at this width or below, default 1025
options.lag: Delay in ms before the cursor position is handed over, default 15 (measured, the original starts about 40ms late) — the original passes it as React state and framer starts on the next render, which causes the lag. 0 means immediately

note: Fill takes CSS values (var(--…)) as is. Without CustomEase it falls back to power1.out

from.where: Every page .g-mouse — Hero scroll-icon · work card view (work color) · Be-Say-Do panel rotate
